newsitem.title: USA: Equity Residential buys 13 properties for $166 mln.
newsitem.headline: Equity Residential buys 13 properties for $166 mln.

text.p: Equity Residential Properties Trust, a real estate investment trust, said Monday it has acquired 13 properties comprising 3,304 units, for a total purchase price of $166,630,000.
Park Place I and II apartments in Plymouth, Minn., a suburb of Minneapolis, and Hunters Glen in Chesterfield, Mo., a suburb of St. Louis, mark the company's entry into those two markets.
Nationwide, Equity Residential now owns or has investments in 231 properties in 31 states, consisting of 68,712 units, the company said.

Other properties acquired are located in Jacksonville, Fla.; Albuquerque, N.M.; Nashville, Tenn.; Raleigh, N.C.; Chino Hills, Calif.; Chatsworth, Calif.; San Antonio, Texas; Aurora, Colo.; San Diego, Calif.; and Costa Mesa, Calif.
